links.outcome: Hallucinated content in LLM responses to implant-complication vignettes, compared across four models
links.effect: Significant differences between models in hallucinated content (Cochran's Q p = 0.035), with DeepSeek V3.2 having the highest burden.
links.quote: Cochran's Q tests found significant differences in major harmful recommendations (p = 0.041) and hallucinated content (p = 0.035), with DeepSeek V3.2 having the highest burden.

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy and management completeness against guideline-informed scenarios
links.effect: Models differed significantly (completeness/actionability p = 0.001; diagnostic accuracy p = 0.023). Gemini 3.1 scored 4.30 vs DeepSeek V3.2 3.58 overall (adjusted p = 0.003). Differences appeared only in difficult scenarios.
links.quote: After Holm correction, Gemini 3.1 scored significantly higher than DeepSeek V3.2 in all domains and overall (4.30 vs 3.58; adjusted p = 0.003); no other comparisons were significant.

screen.reason: The study evaluated the diagnostic, management, communication, and safety performance of four LLMs across 24 clinical vignettes evaluated by expert clinicians, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
